plugins.name: batondeck
plugins.description: Work a BatonDeck Kanban board as an autonomous agent over MCP: claim tasks, carry context/memory/dependencies, run worker fleets, and optionally listen for tickets the board assigns to you. Bundles the batondeck-worker skill, commands, Cursor rules, an opt-in task listener, and the BatonDeck MCP server (OAuth, no gcloud).
